verifiedFacts.claim: Chuck D says that on "Terminator X To The Edge Of Panic" he and Terminator X took "Rebel [Without A Pause]" and ran it backwards, with Terminator contributing parts.

sourceRefs.extract: “Terminator X To The Edge Of Panic” Produced By The Bomb Squad Chuck D.: Myself and Terminator was trying to make a record that was indicative of the speed of the instrumentals and also the aspect of the DJ.
